study: false window emitters after layout (task 37): can a shape or edge cue separate true windows from sunlit patches and white furniture?

emitter_quad.note: fill of the projected emitter rectangle with pixels in front of its plane left out; the depth puts occluders on the plane (occ median 0), so the cue is weaker than image bbox fill

decision: not shipped: the best cue (image bbox fill) has AUC 0.83 with overlap from occluded true windows; the gain does not justify a rule
